decisions.rationale: Intended Mega: Swampert. Gyarados+Arch lead pressures Incin/Rotom/King with Intimidate+ElectroShot/Aura while denying free FakeOut value; Pelipper+MegaSwampert back completes rain SwiftSwim endgame vs Skarm/Noivern/Gengar. Avoids pure rain lead into dual Protect/Defiant.

Intended Mega: none — Gengar benched; this mode needs no Shadow Tag and Mega Gengar loses to +1 Gyarados/rain Swampert. Lead Rotom+Kingambit turn-one job: Rotom's Tbolt deletes Gyarados or Pelipper (4x) while Kingambit Protects if Archaludon is up or Sucker-chips; Defiant flips Intimidate. Incineroar adds Intimidate/Fake Out vs their physical side and walls Gholdengo; Noivern's Super Fang + Kingambit Sucker finish Archaludon and Mega Swampert. Kingambit stays preserved as the rain answer.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1. Opp: aggressive, splits targets. G2 team Pelipper/Swampert/Archaludon/Gyarados; led Gyarados+Archaludon, rain closed — rain not always their lead. Gyarados DDs then EQs even beside own Archaludon (feeds Stamina); +1 Jolly Gyarados (219) outruns Mega Gengar(200)/Noivern(192)/Tailwind Rotom(216). Archaludon (LO Stamina, special): Tbolt 0.5x, Leaf Storm 0.25x, Kowtow NEUTRAL (corrected — only Iron Head resisted), physical hits feed Def; dies to chip+LO recoil — Noivern Super Fang ignores Stamina/screens, best answer; Aura Sphere 4x OHKOs Kingambit — never eat it. Verified: Rotom Tbolt 4x→Pelipper/Gyarados OHKO; Leaf Storm 4x→Swampert OHKO; BG Kowtow→Gholdengo OHKO; Iron Head vs Grimmsnarl 72.8-138.8%; M-Swampert Ice Punch vs Rotom 54-94% (no OHKO — Rotom can eat one and Leaf Storm back); Kingambit Sucker vs M-Swampert 29.5-51.4%. Grimmsnarl Fake Outs on entry; Good as Gold blocks Parting Shot/Whirlwind. Pelipper speed 85-117 straddles Rotom 108. Mega Swampert rain (244) outruns all — answer Kingambit Sucker + Protect-stall, not Rotom head-on. Rotom Levitate still unrevealed — live EQ trap vs Gyarados/Swampert. Rotom quad-resists Electro Shot, resists Draco — walls Archaludon long-term. Kingambit Protect counter resets after any non-Protect turn. G3 team: Rotom+Kingambit lead, Incineroar+Noivern back, NO Mega. Turn 1 vs Gyarados+Archaludon: Tbolt Gyarados, Kingambit Protect. Preserve Kingambit for Swampert; Super Fang then Sucker/Iron Head finishes Archaludon.

decisions.rationale: Aura Sphere guaranteed OHKOes Kingambit through Defiant +1. Gyarados outspeeds all Rotom and Ice Fangs for 36-66% chip (or forces switch) before Tbolt can OHKO it. EQ risks ally chip and misses Levitate Rotom. Removing Kingambit first is the priority wincon.
Bring Pelipper to start rain now; Arch lives both and can Electro Shot or Aura next. Swampert into LeafStorm risk and no rain yet is worse. Rain enables Swift Swim mega later and Arch Electro.

Tbolt is a guaranteed OHKO on Gyarados through the full legal range, removing the DD/EQ threat before it snowballs. Kingambit Protects to dodge the 4x Aura Sphere and reset its Protect counter for the Swampert endgame. Rotom quad-resists Electro Shot and resists Draco, and Levitate blanks EQ, so it safely eats anything aimed its way. Next: Noivern Super Fang + Sucker/Iron Head cleans Archaludon.

decisions.rationale: Rain up; KO Kingambit now with HH-boosted LO Aura Sphere (4x) before Sucker/Defiant snowball. Pelipper HH outspeeds and enables; Arch Spe 119 beats Kingambit. Respect Rotom TBolt on Pel next.

Rotom is my only Pelipper (Tbolt 4x) and Swampert (Leaf Storm 4x) answer, so it cannot risk a faster Hurricane at 48% — Protect. Kingambit must not eat the 4x Aura Sphere with Protect on reduced odds, so pivot to Incineroar, which tanks it (2x) plus Sitrus. Next turn Fake Out + Thunderbolt removes Pelipper regardless of its speed roll, and Fake Out + Leaf Storm is the stored answer for Mega Swampert.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit cannot enter — Aura Sphere 4x OHKOs it. Noivern resists Aura Sphere (0.5x), holds Focus Sash vs Draco Meteor, and at 192 Spe outspeeds both foes; Super Fang bypasses Stamina and halves Archaludon. Rotom stays for the 4x Tbolt on Pelipper and Leaf Storm vs a potential Swampert; Kingambit preserved as the Sucker Punch answer to Mega Swampert.

decisions.rationale: Peli dies to any Rotom Electric; Protect removes that. Arch Draco guarantees Noivern Sash break (147%+) unless Protect. LO recoil fine. Survives Rotom Tbolt range on Arch. Sets up clean KO next; Tailwind still better faced with Sash gone than losing Peli.
decisions.notebook: Rain core: Pelipper Damp Rock + Mega Swampert; Arch Electro Shot; Gyarados Intimidate DD. Opp: Mega Gengar Timid, Rotom-M Magnet Modest Levitate (LeafStorm/Tbolt/VoltSwitch/Protect, Protect-heavy), Skarm Sturdy Lefties, Incin Adamant Sitrus Intim, Kingambit Adamant BG Defiant (Kowtow/IronHead/Sucker/Protect; enters on Incin KO, Protects then Suckers low threats, Defiant +1 post-Intim), Noivern Sash Infiltrator Tailwind. Leads vary (Incin+Rotom or King+Rotom into Incin+Gengar); often leave Skarm/Noivern. Prefer Gyarados/Arch lead over pure Mega Swampert rain into this; respect Kingambit cleanup + dual Protect. Game3 brought King/Rotom/Incin/Noivern (no Gengar/Skarm).

decisions.rationale: Noivern (192) moves first, Super Fang chunks Archaludon to ~45% through Stamina, setting up chip+LO recoil or Kingambit Kowtow finish. Rotom Tbolt removes Pelipper (verified 4x OHKO) unless it Protects/switches. Rotom is safe from Aura Sphere; only max-speed Pelipper Hurricane high-roll KOs it, a narrow risk worth taking since trading Rotom still leaves Kingambit+Noivern ahead vs chunked Archaludon.

decisions.rationale: KO 1% Noivern with rain Electro Shot (SE, +Spa). Switch Pelipper into Swampert: Ground immunity dodges Rotom Electric, preserves rain core for Mega Swift Swim vs Kingambit.

Noivern (192) moves first, so Super Fang chips Archaludon into Kingambit Sucker/LO-recoil range before it likely falls; Rotom's 4x Thunderbolt removes the rain setter through its reduced Protect. Only a fast Pelipper plus high Hurricane roll punishes, and Protecting hands Pelipper tempo anyway. Kingambit then enters vs a ~7% Archaludon with Rotom's Leaf Storm preserved for the Swampert reveal.

decisions.rationale: Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Arch 8% dies to any Kingambit hit; Sucker beats Aura so Arch must Protect. Mega Swampert Swift Swim outspeeds Rotom in rain and Ice Punches first—often KOs 47% Rotom and denies Leaf Storm (4x OHKO). EQ wastes on Levitate and needs Arch Protect. Next turn Aura/EQ cleans Kingambit.

Leaf Storm 4x is my only Swampert answer and thus the win condition; once Swampert megas, Ice Punch out-speeds and KOs Rotom every turn, so Protecting just loses slowly — I must fire now and win whenever Swampert targets Kingambit, EQs (Levitate), switches, or Protects. Sucker Punch's +1 priority KOs 8% Archaludon even at +2 Def before its 4x Aura Sphere can hit Kingambit, securing the endgame; Pelipper then dies to Thunderbolt.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, G3. Opp aggressive, splits targets; doubled Incineroar with Helping Hand Aura Sphere. G3 4th = Swampert (confirmed; rain team). Archaludon LO Stamina special: physical hits feed Def; Aura Sphere 4x vs Kingambit (~KO range even at -1) — never eat it; Kowtow/Sucker neutral KO it at low HP even +2 Def. Verified: Rotom Tbolt 4x OHKOs Pelipper/Gyarados; Leaf Storm 4x OHKOs Swampert even at -2; M-Swampert rain Swift Swim (180-244) outruns all — never race it; its Ice Punch KOs Rotom from 50% (54-94%); Kingambit Sucker vs M-Swampert 29.5-51.4%, Kowtow ~30-36%; EQ 2HKOs Kingambit (~47% each), Liquidation rain ~52-61%. Pelipper speed 85-117 straddles Rotom 108; its Hurricane 32.5-75% vs Rotom. Endgame plan: if Swampert falls, Tbolt Pelipper, Sucker finishes chipped Arch; Kingambit Protects to dodge Aura Sphere.

decisions.rationale: Arch 8% dies to any King hit; Aura OHKOs King. Speed order Swampert>Arch>King: dual attack KOs before King moves unless Sucker/Protect. EQ chips 53-91% if Sucker KOs Arch or Protect blocks Aura. Arch Protect has reduced odds and loses the guaranteed KO window.
Automatic: only one legal joint action.

Sucker Punch's +1 priority KOs 8% Archaludon (neutral Dark, even at +2 Def) before its guaranteed-OHKO Aura Sphere can fire. Swampert's Liquidation maxes at 77.7%, so Kingambit survives the turn. Protect just delays Arch's threat while giving free Liquidations. After Arch falls, chip Swampert with Sucker each turn it attacks and hope for roll luck; it's the only line that keeps any win path alive.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, G3. Opp aggressive, splits targets, doubles with Helping Hand; will sac low-HP mons' Protect to preserve wincons. Verified calcs: Kingambit Sucker/Kowtow (neutral Dark vs Steel/Dragon) KOs low-HP Archaludon even at +2 Def; Arch LO Aura Sphere guaranteed OHKOs Kingambit (115-193% at neutral SpA) — never eat it, Sucker's +1 priority is the only way to strike first (Kingambit 70 spe). M-Swampert Liquidation in rain 46.4-77.7% vs Kingambit (no OHKO); EQ stronger 1v1 (~63%) once no ally adjacent. Sucker vs M-Swampert 29.5-51.4%. M-Swampert rain Swift Swim (180-244) outruns everything — never race without priority. Rotom Tbolt 4x OHKOs Pelipper/Gyarados; Leaf Storm 4x OHKOs Swampert even at -2. Pelipper speed 85-117 straddles Rotom 108. Physical hits into Archaludon feed Stamina Def — use special or finish at low HP only.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit 1% only threat left. EQ KOs through any non-Protect (Flying ally immune). Pelipper Protect covers Sucker/priority and forces another turn if it Protects; rain remains.

Kingambit is my last Pokemon at 1%; both foes outspeed and any hit KOs, and no attack OHKOs either foe, so no line wins outright. Attacking means moving last and fainting; Sucker Punch only trades my last mon for meaningless chip. Protect is guaranteed (no consecutive use) and keeps Kingambit alive, preserving residual win equity via opponent error or timer while Sucker Punch remains available next turn.

decisions.rationale: Kingambit 1% alone; EQ KOs through any non-Protect and Flying-immune ally. WB rain Water also KOs if Protect fails. Both outspeed; residual rain. Next turn still faster sans SS.

Kingambit is my last mon at 1%; both foes outspeed and any hit KOs, and neither Kowtow nor Sucker OHKOs either foe, so no line truly wins. Sucker Punch's +1 priority is the only way to act before fainting; Swampert at 100% has no reason to Protect and is the near-certain attacker, so Sucker into it guarantees damage and keeps nominal pressure if they misplay around priority. Protect is 33% and even success leaves no route to two KOs.
decisions.notebook: Series 1-1, G3 all but decided. Opp tendencies: aggressive, splits targets, loves Helping Hand + attack doubles; sacs low-HP mons' Protect to preserve wincons; will hard-swap Swampert into Electric moves (Ground immune) — don't fire Tbolt at a slot with a live Ground switch; hold Electric coverage until Pelipper is confirmed unprotected or Swampert already in. Verified calcs: Kingambit Sucker/Kowtow KOs low-HP Archaludon even at +2 Def; Arch LO Aura Sphere OHKOs Kingambit — never eat it, Sucker's +1 is the only way to strike first (70 spe). M-Swampert Liquidation in rain 46.4-77.7% vs Kingambit; Sucker vs M-Swampert 29.5-51.4%; Kowtow ~74-87% vs Pelipper, no OHKOs available. M-Swampert rain Swift Swim (180-244) outruns everything — never race without priority. Rotom Tbolt 4x OHKOs Pelipper/Gyarados; Leaf Storm 4x OHKOs Swampert even at -2. Pelipper speed 85-117 straddles Rotom 108. Physical hits into Archaludon feed Stamina Def — use special or finish at low HP only. Lesson: Kingambit is the only real answer to Archaludon; preserve its HP for the endgame rather than trading it early.

reflections.summary: Won because the rain-core preview (Pelipper + intended Mega Swampert, with Arch/Gyarados) perfectly matched their King/Rotom/Incin/Noivern bring; Arch removed Sash Noivern, Ice Punch deleted Rotom, then Swift Swim EQ overcame Kingambit Protect/Sucker cycles.
reflections.adjustment: Keep the same four and Mega Swampert vs this bring, but open Gyarados+Arch more often to apply early Intimidate before Kingambit enters.
reflections.notebook: Rain core: Pelipper Damp Rock + Mega Swampert; Arch Electro Shot; Gyarados Intimidate DD. Opp: Mega Gengar Timid, Rotom-M Magnet Modest Levitate (LeafStorm/Tbolt/VoltSwitch/Protect, Protect-heavy), Skarm Sturdy Lefties, Incin Adamant Sitrus Intim, Kingambit Adamant BG Defiant (Kowtow/IronHead/Sucker/Protect; enters on Incin KO, Protects then Suckers low threats, Defiant +1 post-Intim), Noivern Sash Infiltrator Tailwind SuperFang. Leads vary (Incin+Rotom or King+Rotom); often leave Skarm/Gengar. Rain Mega Swampert + Arch/Gyarados beats their no-Gengar brings; still prefer Gyarados/Arch lead to Intimidate before Kingambit cleanup + dual Protect.

reflections.summary: Lost the decider because the anti-rain plan had a single point of failure and it broke: Rotom-Mow was the only Swampert answer, but it fired Thunderbolt into the opponent's known Ground-immune hard-swap (turn 4), then was OHKO'd by M-Swampert's Ice Punch before ever using Leaf Storm. That left Kingambit alone vs Pelipper + M-Swampert — a verified unwinnable endgame (no OHKO lines, outsped in rain, EQ KO'd). The preview bring itself was fragile: four mons with no Mega, no weather control, and one
reflections.adjustment: Versus this rain core, treat Rotom as a protected wincon, not a pivot: never click Electric moves while Swampert can still hard-swap (hold Tbolt for confirmed Pelipper/Gyarados or once Swampert is already in), and always switch or Protect Rotom against M-Swampert since Ice Punch OHKOs from full. Support it with Fake Out/Tailwind so Leaf Storm actually fires, and reconsider the bring — if the roster offers a Mega, a second Swampert check, or weather disruption, it outranks Noivern/Incineroar here
reflections.notebook: Series lost 1-2 (G3 decider lost to the rain core). Opp tendencies: aggressive, splits targets, loves Helping Hand + attack doubles; sacs low-HP mons' Protect to preserve wincons; reliably hard-swaps Swampert into telegraphed Electric moves (repeated in G3) — never fire Tbolt while a Ground-immune swap is live; hold Electric for confirmed Pelipper/Gyarados or once Swampert is already in. Leads Pelipper with Damp Rock — expect 8-turn rain from turn 1. Archaludon's Electro Shot fires immediately in rain (no charge turn). Verified calcs: Kingambit Sucker/Kowtow KOs low-HP Archaludon even at +2 Def; Arch LO Aura Sphere OHKOs Kingambit — Sucker's +1 priority is the only way to strike first (70 spe). M-Swampert: Liquidation in rain 46-78% vs Kingambit; EQ (near-)OHKOs Kingambit; Ice Punch OHKOs Rotom-Mow from full — Rotom must switch/Protect, never tank it; Kingambit Sucker vs M-Swampert 29.5-51.4%; Kowtow ~74-87% vs Pelipper, no OHKOs. Swift Swim M-Swampert outruns everything in rain — never race without priority or Tailwind. Rotom Tbolt OHKOs Pelipper/Gyarados; Leaf Storm OHKOs Swampert even at -2, but only if Rotom survives to fire it. Physical hits into Archaludon feed Stamina — chip with Super Fang/special or finish at low HP only. Kingambit is the only real Archaludon answer — preserve its HP for the endgame. Plan vs rain: Rotom is the lone Swampert check, so guard it as the wincon (Fake Out/Tailwind support, switch on M-Swampert); Kingambit alone vs Pelipper+M-Swampert is unwinnable.
